document.title: Peraturan BPJS Kesehatan 2/2024: Penagihan, pembayaran, dan denda iuran JKN

delta.note: The regulation amends BPJS Kesehatan procedures for collecting contributions and arrears (cooperation with JKN cadres and agents, compliance supervision), deletes local-government payment provisions, and adjusts reinstatement and penalty rules for late JKN contributions. It does not change contribution rates, wage bases, or anything that enters the gross income or deductions of permanent employees for PPh 21. Penalties and arrears borne by the employer for PPU participants are a collection and enforcement matter, not a change to the PPh 21 calculation.
